description.p: Hey Look! is a free, open-source desktop mail client with no ads, no analytics code and no account to create. Mail goes directly between the app and your mail servers.
Hey Look! là ứng dụng thư miễn phí, mã nguồn mở cho máy tính, không có quảng cáo, không có mã phân tích và không cần tạo tài khoản. Thư đi trực tiếp giữa ứng dụng và máy chủ thư của bạn.

Hey Look! est un client de messagerie de bureau gratuit et open source, sans publicité, sans code d’analyse et sans compte à créer. Les e-mails circulent directement entre l’application et vos serveurs de messagerie.
Hey Look!是一款免费开源的桌面邮件客户端，没有广告，没有分析代码，也无需创建账户。邮件直接在应用与您的邮件服务器之间传输。

Hey Look! es un cliente de correo de escritorio gratuito y de código abierto, sin anuncios, sin código de analítica y sin ninguna cuenta que crear. El correo va directamente entre la aplicación y tus servidores de correo.
Hey Look!は、広告もアナリティクスのコードもアカウント作成も不要な、無料のオープンソースのデスクトップメールクライアントです。メールは、アプリとお使いのメールサーバーの間で直接やり取りされます。
Hey Look! ist ein kostenloser Open-Source-Mailclient für den Desktop ohne Werbung, ohne Analytics-Code und ohne Konto. E-Mails gehen direkt zwischen der App und Ihren Mailservern.

Hey Look! — бесплатный почтовый клиент для компьютера с открытым исходным кодом. В нём нет рекламы и кода аналитики, не нужно создавать учётную запись. Почта идёт напрямую между приложением и вашими почтовыми серверами.

description.p: The start-with-Windows entry shows the window by default, with a new switch to start in the tray; One Inbox stays in Favorites, accounts can be dragged by their whole header, and the new-mail sound is quieter.
Fixes the white rectangle that stayed on the Windows desktop after Hey Look! started with Windows or in the tray, and makes the start-with-Windows entry and the tray start more dependable.

Mail rules (renamed from Filters) with a Create rule dialog, and fixes for the white window after an in-app update, pictures in replies, endless loading with filters, browser autofill over the search box and mail moved into another folder.
Settings search, calendar series and CalDAV sync, Confidential mail handling, more AI Assistant settings, and many fixes.
Pop-out windows for writing and reading, a much richer editor, autosave with crash recovery, and many fixes.
First release.
